title: WatchtowerReconciledAssessment
description: Authoritative output of the policy reconciler (specification 5.8) and the payload of the status API and notifier. Separates the three status fields the design requires: deterministic lifecycle state, display status which a model may narrow, and notification_status which is deterministic-only and is the sole field the notifier reads. assessment.schema.json remains the model-produced contract and is embedded here unchanged, so the advisory-mode boundary is expressible and testable rather than conventional. Every field is capped so a serialized instance is finite.

run_id.description: Identifier of the execution this result describes, or null when no execution is bound.

execution_epoch.description: Zero-based ordinal of the execution within the session. Increments when a resume binds the same session ID.

state.description: Deterministic lifecycle, owned by session discovery and process evidence. Never model-assigned.

status.description: Display status. A model may narrow this within the row its state permits; it may never move it to another row.

notification_status.description: Delivery-authoritative status, derived only from deterministic lifecycle and rule signals. The notifier reads this and nothing else. In advisory mode no model output can reach it.

status_epoch.description: Increments whenever notification_status changes to a different value, making each entry into a state a distinct episode.

attention_epoch.description: Increments on every deterministic needs_attention transition from false to true, so a signal that clears and reactivates is a new episode even when notification_status never changed.

needs_attention.description: Deterministic. A model may not set or clear it.

active_signals.description: Deterministic signal identities active at reconciliation, the input to signal_fingerprint.

signal_fingerprint.description: Stable digest of the sorted (severity, kind, id) triples in active_signals. Part of the notification deduplication key.

model_assessment.description: The model result, unchanged, or null when none was produced or it was rejected. Advisory in v0.1.0: present here for display and context, never consulted for delivery.

report.description: Run report state, or null when no report is due.

provisional.description: True for an idle report, where no process evidence exists. An execution-terminal report is final for its execution and still supersedable by a resume.
